claims.summary: A genitive chain appears when several genitive groups are chained and each one depends on the preceding noun.

In крыша дома моего друга — 'the roof of the house of my friend', the main nucleus is крыша 'roof'. Дома is in the genitive singular and depends on крыша 'roof': it is 'the roof of the house'. Within this group, моего друга is also in the genitive and depends on дома 'the house': 'the house of my friend'.

Provides examples of genitive chains in Russian, such as крыша дома моего друга 'the roof of the house of my friend', директор школы нашего района 'the director of the school of our district', and обсуждение результатов исследования компании 'the discussion of the results of the study of the company'.
